🖥 Iran, Kazakhstan discuss ways to expand cooperation in sports, tourism

📌 Tehran, IRNA – Iran’s ambassador to Kazakhstan, Ali-Akbar Jokar, and Kazakhstan’s Minister of Tourism and Sports, Yerbol Myrzabossynov, have discussed ways to enhance bilateral cooperation in sports and tourism.

Jokar met with Myrzabossynov on Monday to discuss ways to expand bilateral cooperation in sports and tourism.
​
The two sides emphasized expanding interactions, actively participating in international events, and holding specialized meetings to introduce the tourism potential and capabilities of Iran and Kazakhstan.
​
Referring to the US attacks on a sports hall in Lamerd County and other sports facilities in Iran, Jokar stressed the need for the global sports community to react to such criminal actions.
​
Myrzabossynov, for his part, welcomed the growing relations between the two countries and expressed his country’s readiness to expand bilateral cooperation with Iran in sports and tourism.

💬 ISC unveils updated system to track brilliant scientific figures

📌 Shiraz, IRNA – The updated version of the “System for Tracking Researchers’ and Scientists’ Honors” of the ‘Islamic World Science & Technology Monitoring and Citation Institute’ (ISC) was unveiled to identify outstanding scientific, technological, and innovation figures in Iran and Islamic countries.

Mohammad Mehdi Alavianmehr, head of ISC, said: This system identifies outstanding figures based on national and international honors and awards, and serves as a comprehensive database of researchers’ scientific and technological achievements.
​
In the updated system, recipients of various national and international honors and awards from different years can be identified.
​
Additionally, a personal profile has been created for each prominent scientific, technological, and innovation figure, displaying a comprehensive record of their honors in different years.
​
“The Islamic World Science and Technology Monitoring and Citation Institute” (ISC), formerly known as the Islamic World Science Citation Center, is a scientometric database and research evaluation system located in Shiraz, Iran.
